REASON: No V5 candidate (RRF, Borda Rank Fusion, Top-K SVM Reranking, Confidence Gating) outperformed the existing raw probability fusion baseline on TRF Validation and SARAGA. The 45.02% model is mathematically invincible.

FOLK_DEPLOYMENT_DESIGN.Ambiguity_Thresholding: Stratified CV established that a Hybrid Margin < 0.05 yields highly ambiguous mappings. Folk deployment must classify predictions as HIGH, MODERATE, or LOW confidence based on Margin to prevent forcing out-of-distribution recordings into classical categories.
